title: ValidationResult
description: Outcome of validating a runtime at a given level on the project's evidence ladder. Not an immutable resource: it carries no content id (a canonical hash may still be computed for change detection; see schemas/CANONICALIZATION.md).

runtime_id.description: Reference to the RuntimeManifest that was validated, format 'sha256:<hex>'.

level.description: Validation level this result reports on.

checks.description: Individual checks performed at this level.

evidence.description: Optional evidence reference or note for the check outcome.

evidence_level.description: Highest evidence level substantiated by these checks.
